title: Build the DFT and read its bins in hertz
brief: Build the DFT as a matrix of complex sinusoids, keep the half of it a real signal needs, and convert bin numbers to hertz to find the tones in a frame.
hints: np.outer(k, k) with k = np.arange(n) gives every product k * m at once, so np.exp(-2j * np.pi * np.outer(k, k) / n) is the whole matrix.
The DFT is the matrix times the signal: W @ x. Each row of W is the complex sinusoid for one bin.
A real signal has X[n - k] equal to the conjugate of X[k], so keep bins 0 to n // 2: that is n // 2 + 1 of them.
Bin k sits at k * sample_rate / n_fft hertz.
